name: CSO_CONTENT_TEXT
description: This table contains the meta data for each content record. It has all versions of all locales. The publishing dates, workflow steps, etc are all stored here. Each CONTENT record can have 1 or more CONTENTTEXT records associated with it. The CONTENT record is the master record.

columns.name: BASED_MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: If this record is a localized version, this field is the used to capture the major version of the record used to create this localized record.

columns.name: BASED_MINOR_VERSION
columns.description: If this record is a localized version, this field is the used to capture the minor version of the record used to create this localized record.

columns.name: BASED_LOCALE_ID
columns.description: If this record is a localized version, this field is the used to capture the source locale used to create this localized record.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content table record.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime the content text was last edited that would affect subscription notifications.

columns.name: INDEX_MASTER_IDENTIFIERS
columns.description: Concatenated string composed of all of the channel attributes marked as the master identifier in the channel setup. The order of the fields is based on the the order in the content channel design. This data may be truncated if it is greater than the available length in the database.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: The locale associated with the current record.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: This is the main version number that indicates which version has been published. 1.x where 1 is the major version number.

columns.name: MINOR_VERSION
columns.description: The minor version number is an interim version that indicates work in process. The minor version number is incremented any time a change is made until publishing. At publication the minor version number is set to zero and the major version number is incremented to the next highest number.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: The obsolete GUID of the current owner of the document, this is not necessarily the same as the creator of the document.

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.description: de-normalized name of the document owner.

columns.name: PRIORITY_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to LOOKUP_CODE table containing the list of available priority codes.

columns.name: DISPLAY_POSITION_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to LOOKUP_CODE table containing the list of available display position codes.

columns.name: PUBLISH_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime when the record was published.

columns.name: PUBLISHED
columns.description: Flag indicating that the record was published.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID of the user associated with this record.

columns.name: WF_STEP_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the workflow step that his record is currently at. Null indicates that the record is not in workflow at the moment.

columns.name: REQUIRES_TRANSLATION
columns.description: Flag indicating if the record needs to be translated to another supported locale. The task functionality gives a better view as to which locales need to be translated.

columns.name: ANSWERED
columns.description: Deprecated. Flag indicating if the record was moderated. Only applies if this record is a threaded discussion record and the channel has been marked as “requires moderation‿

columns.name: LATEST_VERSION
columns.description: Flag indicating whether or not this record is the latest version for the content record. This flag is maintained by IM as content is changed.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: De-normalized username associated with the user login.

columns.name: CREATE_DATE
columns.description: Datetime the record was originally created. This is primarily used if the content was imported from another system and the create date was captured in the import file.

columns.name: CHECKED_OUT
columns.description: Flag indicating that the record was checked out for editing by another person.

columns.name: CHECKED_OUT_BY_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID of the user that checked out the content record.

columns.name: DISPLAY_END_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime when the record is no longer valid to be viewed. The record may still be published but it will not be returned to the JSP tag library.

columns.name: DISPLAY_START_DATE
columns.description: This is the date when the record is available to be viewed. The record can be published but if the start date is after the current date it will not be returned by the JSP tag library.

columns.name: EVENT_END_DATE
columns.description: If the channel supports event calendars, then this column specifies the datetime the event is scheduled to end.

columns.name: EVENT_START_DATE
columns.description: If the channel supports event calendars, then this column specifies the datetime the event is scheduled to start.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: This is the Reference to content record's document id.

columns.name: WFSTEP_NOTIFICATION_OVERRIDE
columns.description: Allows the content editor to override when the default workflow step notification email is sent. By default.

columns.name: ALIAS_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to a CONTENT record that is an alias to this content record.

columns.name: PENDING
columns.description: Flag indicating that the record was published with a future display date and hence pending

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: This is the comment for the column ANSWER_ID.

columns.name: DISPLAY_REVIEW_DATE
columns.description: Datetime of the next scheduled review of the contenttext record.

columns.name: ARTICLE_STATUS_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the article status in the ARTICLE_STATUS table.

columns.name: OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The ID of the current owner of the document, this is not necessarily the same as the creator of the document.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user associated with this record.

columns.name: CHECKED_OUT_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that checked out the content record.

columns.name: BU_ORG_IDS_1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. This column value indicates the Business Units assigned to this Article version.

columns.name: NOTIFY_FLAG
columns.description: This flag decides if the version in this row is to be considered for notifying users about change.
